notes.title: New! Subscriptions for Typing Instructor for Kids
notes.content: Get your Kids typing this summer for a few dollars a month. Select from one of 11 complete Typing Plans for ages 5 to 12, for beginner and advanced typists. There are entertaining ways to practice with lots of fun games and activities. Your kids will be motivated to complete their typing plan, fill their treasure chest, and reach the Castle to become the ruler of Typer Island. Bonus for families! Up to 5 kids can log-in and track their own plan.
